admission.justification: A refusal type only the retry route catches would escape the held opener and leave it claiming a delivery it never made; the held-seat case exercises the opener on a real refusal and would fail on any other type.

applicability: Every refusal a hand-over write or restore raises to a caller.
conditions: A held seat's opener answers cannot-open and releases its delivery claim rather than reporting a delivery it did not make.
The retry route answers 409 for the same refusal.
exclusions: Harness or host failures, which are not hand-over refusals.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_paseo_agent_tools.py held-seat retry and release cases

statement: Every hand-over refusal is a ValueError, so a held seat's opener answers cannot-open and releases its delivery claim while the retry route answers 409.
